classifications.rationale: The President presently imposes mandatory ethical duties on federal employees; the employee obligations apply through the order itself, although regulations will implement them.
classifications.evidence: Employees shall not use public office for private gain.

classifications.rationale: The segment inseparably combines present employee prohibitions, including an immediate outside-income restriction, with commands requiring the Office of Government Ethics to produce later binding regulations.
classifications.evidence: The Office of Government Ethics shall be responsible for administering this order by:

classifications.rationale: The segment combines a present legal treatment of EOP agencies, later mandatory agency regulations and training, and internal delegations of presidential authority; these materially different postures cannot receive one non-mixed code.
classifications.evidence: those agencies shall be treated as one agency under section 207(c) of title 18, United States Code.

classifications.rationale: The President immediately revokes prior executive orders and preserves existing actions, contractual permissions, and confidentiality duties, combining internal administrative revocation with present substantive legal consequences.
classifications.evidence: employees may carry out preexisting contractual obligations entered into before April 12, 1989.
